/-!
# Parsers

What a parser of this library hands to its handler for each syntax tree and at which token, the
version policies that restrict the parse of a script, and the properties of the traversal. An
error named in code, such as `UnsupportedVersion`, is the error of the library's interface that
the definition specifies.
-/
